# usamazahid.design

> Independent Brand & User-Centric Product Designer. Creator of Brand-to-URL: brand strategy, visual identity systems, user-centric product UI/UX design, and Next.js web engineering as one unified 4-week delivery sequence for founders and growing brands. Based in Lahore, working globally.

> Last updated: 2026-10-26
> Full Knowledge Base & Citations: https://usamazahid.design/llms-full.txt

## About

- [About Usama Zahid](https://usamazahid.design/about/): Background, method, daily practice, tools, and influences of the single operator.
- [CV & Full Record](https://usamazahid.design/cv/): 6 years in brand identity, 3 years in user-centric product UI/UX. 50+ projects shipped across 30+ clients. Complete work history with stack and capabilities.
- [Brand to URL](https://usamazahid.design/brand-to-url/): Full-system design and code from concept to deployed brand and website in 4 weeks.
- [Hire Usama Zahid](https://usamazahid.design/hire/): Recruiter and founder overview: role fit, outcomes, experience timeline, and portfolio proof.

## Services

- [Services Overview](https://usamazahid.design/services/): Four tracks — Brand Systems ($12K+), Product Design ($14K+), Web Engineering ($14K+), Brand Strategy ($8K+). Three fixed packages per track.
- [Brand Systems](https://usamazahid.design/services/identity/): Identity systems as operating layers. Type, color, voice, motion.
- [Product Design](https://usamazahid.design/services/product/): End-to-end product design with component libraries and engineering handoff.
- [Web Engineering](https://usamazahid.design/services/engineering/): Next.js, TypeScript, headless CMS. Production code, 95+ Lighthouse.
- [Brand Strategy](https://usamazahid.design/services/strategy/): Positioning, messaging, audience mapping — the decisions before design.
- [Special Offer — Brand-to-URL Sprint](https://usamazahid.design/special-offer/): Two spots. $24K fixed. Strategy, identity, product, and code bundled into one sprint.
